guides.title: Get your stream announced in #live-now
guides.goal: Link your Twitch channel once. Black Bloc posts whenever Discord shows you streaming.

steps.do: Type **/golive** in any channel.
steps.expect: A panel only you can see, with **Link my Twitch channel** on it.

steps.do: Press **Link my Twitch channel** and type the part after twitch.tv/.
steps.expect: The panel reads twitch.tv/your-name. A name somebody else holds is refused without naming them.

steps.do: Start your stream with Discord showing you as **Streaming** (Discord ▸ Settings ▸ Connections ▸ Twitch, Display on profile on).
steps.expect: The announcement posts in the go-live channel with your fans pinged. In shadow, nothing posts and the bot logs what it would have said.

steps.do: Press **Stop announcing my streams** to pause.
steps.expect: The button becomes **Announce my streams again**. Your link is kept.

faults.answer: Announcements are in shadow. The panel's Announcements line says so; a Lead flips it.

faults.symptom: Discord does not show you streaming
faults.answer: Reconnect Twitch under Discord's Connections and turn Display on profile on. The bot reads Discord, not Twitch.

faults.symptom: You went live twice in a short time
faults.answer: The second one waits for the cooldown shown above.
Twitch had no category set. Set one and go live again.

guides.title: Choose what pings you
guides.goal: Turn on the pings you want, follow the streamers you care about, and take yourself off the streamer list if you would rather nobody followed you.

steps.do: Type **/pings**.
steps.expect: A panel titled Your pings, listing every ping you are on and every streamer you follow.

steps.do: Press **Turn event pings on**.
steps.expect: The Events role goes on and the line above says on. The same button now says Turn them off.

steps.do: Press **Turn raid-train pings on**.
steps.expect: The Raid trains role goes on, so you are mentioned when a raid train moves to the next streamer.

steps.do: Press **Follow a streamer…** and pick a name.
steps.expect: Their ping role goes on — Black Bloc makes it on the spot if you are the first to follow them — and the panel lists them.

steps.do: Press **Stop following…** and pick the same name.
steps.expect: The role comes off. This one works even while ping roles are turned off.

steps.do: If you stream and would rather nobody followed you: press **Take me off the streamer list**, then **Yes, take me off**.
steps.expect: You leave the list, going live does not put you back, and your ping role goes too if nobody is wearing it. **Put me back on the list** undoes it.

faults.answer: Staff have not set that role up yet. The panel says so, and **Set up the Events role** or **Set up the raid-train role** on the staff half makes it.
Black Bloc has not seen anybody streaming here yet. Nobody is added by hand — going live is what puts somebody on the list.

faults.symptom: Follow a streamer… says 25 of N
faults.answer: The rest are on Discord's onboarding screen. Staff see the whole list on the dashboard's Go-live tab.

faults.symptom: No Take me off the streamer list
faults.answer: Black Bloc has never seen you streaming, so you are not on the list at all.

guides.title: Propose an event
guides.goal: Pick a day, a start time and a place. Staff approve it and it lands on the server calendar.

steps.do: Type **/event**, then press **My time zone** and pick yours.
steps.expect: The panel shows your zone and the time it is there now. Do this once.

steps.do: Press **Propose an event**, then **Title & details**. Type a title and what it is.
steps.expect: The draft shows your title. Nothing you type is ever thrown away.

steps.do: Pick a **Day**, an **Hour** and a **Minute**.
steps.expect: The When line reads the full date and time in your zone. **Submit** appears only once all three are set.

steps.do: Press **Where** and pick a voice or text channel, or type a place or link.
steps.expect: The Where line shows the channel or the words. Where is optional.

steps.do: Press **Submit**.
steps.expect: A review room named pending-you-title appears. Staff decide there and you are DMed the answer.

faults.symptom: The day you typed was refused
faults.answer: Write it as YYYY-MM-DD. The box reopens with what you typed.
A title and all three of Day, Hour and Minute are needed. The panel says which is missing.
Press **Call one off…** on /event and confirm.

guides.title: Set your birthday, in your own time zone
guides.goal: One date and an opt-in. The wish lands at your midnight, not Phoenix's.

steps.do: Type **/birthday**.
steps.expect: A panel showing the next five birthdays and **Set my birthday**.

steps.do: Press **Set my birthday** and type MM-DD, or MM-DD-YYYY if you want the age shown.
steps.expect: The panel reads the date, your zone and when it next comes round.

steps.do: Set your zone with **/event** ▸ **My time zone** if you have not.
steps.expect: The wish fires at midnight in that zone. Without one it fires at midnight in the server's zone.

faults.answer: Use two-digit month and day: 09-15. Years before 1900 or in the future are refused.
Press **Remove**, then **Yes, forget it**. **Opt out** keeps the date but posts nothing.

guides.title: Make your own voice room
guides.goal: Join the creator channel. Rename, cap, lock and hand your room over from its panel.

steps.do: Join the voice channel named **join to create a channel**.
steps.expect: A channel named after you appears and you are moved into it.

steps.do: Type **/voice**.
steps.expect: Your room's card: **Rename · Limit · Lock · Hide · Bitrate**, then **People… · Region… · Hand it over…**.

steps.do: Press **Lock** to keep people out, **People…** to let one in.
steps.expect: The button reads **Unlock** afterwards. Your choices are remembered for next time.

steps.do: Leave the room when you are done.
steps.expect: It deletes itself once empty.

faults.answer: Temp voice is off or not set up. Ask a Lead.
The owner is still in it. Ask them for **Hand it over…**.
It is above the server's boost level. The panel names the ceiling.

guides.title: Vote in a poll, or make one
guides.goal: Native polls, anonymous panels, date slots and a saved draft you can come back to.

steps.do: To vote, press an answer on the poll message.
steps.expect: Your vote counts once. On an anonymous poll nobody sees who chose what.

steps.do: To make one, type **/poll** and press **Create**.
steps.expect: A box with the question, the options one per line or split by |, the hours, and the kind.

steps.do: Submit the box and check the preview. Pick a channel, then press **Post it**.
steps.expect: Nothing is written until Post it. The poll appears in the channel you picked.

steps.do: To finish early, type **/poll**, pick your poll, press **End**.
steps.expect: The result posts in the channel and the poll closes.

faults.answer: Creating is staff-only on this server. The panel says who may.

faults.symptom: Your poll is waiting on a decision
faults.answer: Review is on. Staff approve it from /poll and you are DMed.
Press **Save the draft** on the preview. /poll offers **Resume the draft** next time. One draft per person.

guides.title: Ask for something to be built
guides.goal: File a request, watch it move to ready, and check the work when you are asked.

steps.do: Type **/request** and press **File a request**.
steps.expect: A box for what you want and why.

steps.do: Submit the box.
steps.expect: A card lands where staff watch — the requests channel, or a post of its own in the requests forum — and you are DMed the number. Staff move it from there.

steps.do: When staff press **Ask them to check**, read the DM and try the work.
steps.expect: The DM says what was built and how to test it. Reply in the server with how it went.

faults.answer: Type **/request**, use **Take one back…**, press **Yes, take it back**.

faults.symptom: You cannot see your requests on the panel
faults.answer: The list is staff-only unless a Lead turns request_panel_own_list on. The website's Requests page shows yours.
Your DMs are closed to server members. The bot pings you in the requests channel instead.

faults.symptom: You cannot find the card again
faults.answer: With a requests forum, your request is a post called #<number> and what you asked for, tagged for wherever it has got to. Without one, every card is in the requests channel.

guides.title: Talk to the bot, and see what it remembers
guides.goal: @-mention it for live answers. /memory shows every note it holds about you, with a Forget.

steps.do: Type **@Black Bloc** and a question: who's live, what's next, birthdays, my roles.
steps.expect: An answer in the bot's voice. Anything else gets a conversation, when the models are on.

steps.do: Type **/memory**.
steps.expect: A panel only you can see, listing every note the bot keeps about you, numbered.

steps.do: Press **Forget one of these…** and pick a number, or **Forget everything**.
steps.expect: The panel redraws without it. The text of a note never reaches any log.

steps.do: Press **Stop remembering me** to opt out.
steps.expect: Everything is wiped and nothing new is written. **Remember me again** turns it back on.

faults.symptom: The bot says memory is off
faults.answer: A Lead has chat_memory_mode off. Your stored notes still show and Forget still works.

faults.symptom: The bot did not answer an @-mention
faults.answer: It answers once per cooldown, and never in ignored channels. Wait and try again.

guides.title: Take an hour on a raid train
guides.goal: Claim a slot, get a DM before it, raid the next streamer.

steps.do: Link your Twitch channel with **/golive** ▸ **Link my Twitch channel** if you have not.
steps.expect: Without a link the train card offers no hour to take.

steps.do: Type **/raidtrain**, press **A train…**, pick the train.
steps.expect: The lineup, one hour per row, with **Take an hour…** under it.

steps.do: Press **Take an hour…** and pick an open hour.
steps.expect: Your name is on that row and the lineup post updates in place. **Give back slot #N** appears.

steps.do: Wait for the DM before your slot.
steps.expect: It names your time, who raids into you and who you raid next, with their Twitch links.

faults.answer: You hold the most hours one person may. Give one back first.

faults.symptom: The hour you wanted was taken
faults.answer: Somebody claimed it first. The card refuses in words and keeps their claim.
None is open, or raid trains are off. The panel says which.

guides.title: Apply to the Twitch Team
guides.goal: Answer the form once. Staff decide, and you are told either way.

steps.do: Type **/apply** and press **Apply for…**, then pick the form.
steps.expect: A box with the form's questions, five at most.

steps.do: Submit the box.
steps.expect: The panel says it went to staff and you are DMed the same. Your application is listed on the panel.

steps.do: Wait for the decision.
steps.expect: A DM with yes or no. A yes names the next step, such as the Team owner sending your twitch.tv invite.

faults.symptom: You already have an application waiting
faults.answer: One open application per form. Press **Take one back…** to withdraw it, then apply again.
The DM says when you may apply again.
No form is taking applications, or applications are off. The panel says which.

guides.title: Approve or deny an event
guides.goal: Decide from the review room, the panel or the website. The requester is told either way.

steps.do: Open the room named pending-name-title, or type **/event** and use **Pick an event…**.
steps.expect: The review card: title, when in every reader's own clock, where, who asked.

steps.do: Press **Approve**, or **Deny** and type a reason.
steps.expect: The room renames to approved- or denied-, the requester is DMed, and an approved event lands on the server calendar.

steps.do: To change something first, open the event on the website's Events page and press **Change it**.
steps.expect: The room and card update. An announcement already posted keeps its text and the reply says so.

steps.do: To take the room away, press **Delete this room** and type why.
steps.expect: The room goes. An open event is cancelled and the requester is DMed the reason.

faults.symptom: You denied and changed your mind
faults.answer: Open the card again and press **Approve after all** while the room exists.

faults.symptom: The announcement landed in the spam channel
faults.answer: Test mode is on. Every post goes to the test channel until it is lifted.
Test mode makes none. Or events_create_scheduled is off.

guides.title: Handle a modmail ticket
guides.goal: Reply, reply as staff, a private note, close. Try it on the practice ticket first.

steps.do: Type **/modmail** and press **Try a fake ticket**, then **Yes, open one**.
steps.expect: A private thread with the same card a real ticket carries. Nobody is DMed.

steps.do: In a ticket, press **Reply** and type your answer.
steps.expect: The member gets it as a DM from you. **Reply as Staff** sends it with no name.

steps.do: Press **Private note** to write something the member never sees.
steps.expect: A note embed in the ticket. No DM.

steps.do: Press **Close…** and type a reason.
steps.expect: The member is DMed, the transcript is filed, and the ticket is tidied away — a channel goes, a thread is archived, and in forum mode the post is tagged **closed** and archived.

faults.symptom: The card is in the spam channel, not the ticket
faults.answer: Test mode redirects real tickets' cards there. The practice thread shows it in place.

faults.symptom: A typed message did not reach the member
faults.answer: modmail_reply_style is buttons. Set it to typing or both under **Setup…** ▸ **Reply style…**.
**Blocked…** ▸ **Block someone…** ▸ pick them ▸ a reason. **Unblock them** reverses it.

faults.symptom: The ticket list scrolls for ever
faults.answer: Press **Setup…** ▸ **Make the forum**, then **Setup…** ▸ **Mode…** ▸ forum. Every ticket is then a post of its own, tagged open while it runs and closed when it ends.

guides.title: Warn, time out, and correct a case
guides.goal: The seven actions, and the four corrections a case can take afterwards.

steps.do: Type **/warn**, **/timeout**, **/kick** or **/ban** with the member and a reason.
steps.expect: A case is written, the modlog gets a card, and the member is DMed if mod_dm_on_action is on.

steps.do: Type **/mod** to see the record, or **/mod @member** for one person.
steps.expect: The newest cases, ten a page, with **A case…** to open one.

steps.do: On a case press **Edit reason…**, **Add a note…** or **Void this case…**.
steps.expect: The card and the modlog card update. Voiding marks it and undoes no punishment.

steps.do: On a voided case press **Restore this case**.
steps.expect: The strike-through goes and the member is DMed that it was put back.

faults.symptom: Voiding did not lift the timeout
faults.answer: By design. Use **/untimeout** or **/unban** for the punishment itself.

faults.symptom: The modlog card did not update
faults.answer: Test mode is on and the modlog is not the test channel.

faults.symptom: A warn still counts toward automod
faults.answer: Only a voided warn stops counting. Check the case reads voided.

guides.title: Arm automod without surprising anyone
guides.goal: Shadow first, read the would-act lines for a week, then on.

steps.do: Type **/automod**.
steps.expect: One panel: the mode, resolved staff, every rule on its own line.

steps.do: Press **A rule…**, pick one, press **Change the numbers…** or **Turn it off**.
steps.expect: The card redraws. A bad number is refused and nothing at all is saved.

steps.do: Press **What automod does…** and pick **shadow**.
steps.expect: Every rule logs what it would do. Nothing is deleted, nobody is timed out.

steps.do: Read the automod log for a week on the website's Automod page.
steps.expect: would_ lines with the rule and the member. Tune the numbers until they are right.

steps.do: Press **What automod does…** and pick **on**, then **Yes, arm it**.
steps.expect: The same rules now act. One automod.mode row.

faults.answer: The staff channel is still the test channel, or no staff role resolves. The panel says which to fix first.

faults.symptom: Somebody was caught who should not be
faults.answer: **Exemptions…** ▸ add their role or the channel. Or void the case on /mod.

faults.symptom: Nothing is caught in test mode
faults.answer: The guard only watches the test channel, and on behaves like shadow there.

guides.title: Set a honeypot trap
guides.goal: A channel nobody should post in. A post there is a ban, once the trap is armed.

steps.do: Type **/honeypot** and press **Setup…**. Keep or change the channel name and submit.
steps.expect: The trap channel is made at the bottom with a pinned do-not-post notice. Setup… disappears.

steps.do: Press **Roles the trap ignores…** and tick the roles that may never be caught.
steps.expect: Staff and bots are never caught anyway. The list above updates.

steps.do: Press **What the trap does…** and pick **shadow**.
steps.expect: A post in the trap is deleted and a would_ban card with **Ban now** appears in the log channel. Nobody is banned.

steps.do: After a quiet week, pick **on**.
steps.expect: A post in the trap bans and purges. The tally on the panel counts it.

faults.answer: No staff role resolves from the staff channel. The panel says what to set.

faults.symptom: The trap was deleted by hand
faults.answer: The bot forgot it already. Setup… is back.
Discord allows 0 to 7. The sentence names the ceiling.

guides.title: Post a role menu
guides.goal: New menu, add roles, post it. Approval-gated or timed roles when you need them.

steps.do: Type **/rolemenu** and press **New menu**. Type a name.
steps.expect: The menu's card, empty, with **Add a role…**.

steps.do: Press **Add a role…**, pick a role, then **Use the role's own name** or **Give it a label…**.
steps.expect: The role is listed with its label and emoji. Repeat for each role.

steps.do: Press **Words…** to set the heading, then **Post it** and pick the channel.
steps.expect: A panel with a select appears in that channel. Members pick from it.

steps.do: For roles staff must approve, press **Ask staff first**. For roles that expire, press **Rules…** and set the days.
steps.expect: The posted panel refreshes itself and says so. Requests land in the approval channel.

faults.answer: It sits above Black Bloc's role in Server Settings ▸ Roles. Move the bot's role up.

faults.symptom: Any channel but the spam channel was refused
faults.answer: Test mode. Post there until it is lifted.
**Take it down** on the card. Nobody loses a role they have.

guides.title: Turn a feature on, off, or to shadow
guides.goal: What each mode means, what hides when a feature is off, and the way back.

steps.do: Type **/settings**.
steps.expect: Every feature's mode on one panel, each line naming the command that changes it.

steps.do: Press **A setting group…**, pick the feature, pick its _mode key, choose the mode.
steps.expect: off does nothing. shadow logs what it would do. on acts. One settings.set row.

steps.do: Wait a minute and press Ctrl+R in Discord.
steps.expect: A feature set to off loses its slash command. shadow keeps it.

steps.do: To bring one back, press **Turn a feature back on…** on /settings.
steps.expect: The command returns within a minute. /settings itself can never hide.

faults.symptom: You want every command showing while features stay off
faults.answer: **Panels & commands…** ▸ **Leave every command showing**.
They read one registry. Refresh the page; a change lands within a minute.
The sentence names the range or the shape. Nothing was saved.
